## API di Seedance 1.5 Pro {#seedance-1-5-pro-api}

Seedance 1.5 Pro è un modello da testo a video e da immagine a video di ByteDance Seed, disponibile sulla Venice API come `seedance-1-5-pro-text-to-video-basic`. Le richieste sono anonimizzate, quindi il provider non vede mai la tua identità.

### Prezzi dell'API di Seedance 1.5 Pro {#seedance-1-5-pro-api-pricing}

| ID modello | Variante | Privacy | Prezzo |
|---|---|---|---|
| `seedance-1-5-pro-text-to-video-basic` | Da testo a video | Anonymized | da $0.0189 / s |
| `seedance-1-5-pro-image-to-video-basic` | Da immagine a video | Anonymized | da $0.0189 / s |

Prezzi per clip di `seedance-1-5-pro-text-to-video-basic`, senza audio:

| Durata | 480p | 720p | 1080p |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4s | $0.08 | $0.17 | $0.38 |
| 5s | $0.09 | $0.21 | $0.48 |
| 6s | $0.11 | $0.26 | $0.57 |
| 7s | $0.13 | $0.30 | $0.67 |
| 8s | $0.15 | $0.34 | $0.77 |

| 10s | $0.19 | $0.43 | $0.96 |
| 11s | $0.21 | $0.47 | $1.05 |
| 12s | $0.23 | $0.51 | $1.15 |

### Come usare l'API di Seedance 1.5 Pro {#how-to-use-the-seedance-1-5-pro-api}

Invia le richieste a `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue` con `"model": "seedance-1-5-pro-text-to-video-basic"` e la tua chiave API.

```bash
# 1. Queue the job (returns a queue_id)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "seedance-1-5-pro-text-to-video-basic",
    "prompt": "Slow aerial drone shot over a misty mountain valley at golden hour",
    "duration": "5s",
    "resolution": "720p",
    "aspect_ratio": "21:9",
    "audio": true
  }'

# 2. Poll until the MP4 is ready
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "seedance-1-5-pro-text-to-video-basic", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output video.mp4
```
